claim.point: pdfquill is the only candidate that supports digital signatures under an allowed licence (it is MIT).
claim.detail: paperforge signs but is AGPL-3.0; inkleaf is Apache-2.0 but cannot sign and its maintainers do not plan to add it.

ask.point: Decide whether to accept pdfquill's maintenance risk: it has had no release in 14 months.
ask.detail: It has 37 open issues, two security-labelled but not affecting signing; the maintainer was last active in March.

stakes.point: If pdfquill turns out to have a bug or security problem we may have to fork and fix it ourselves, because no other candidate meets both requirements.
stakes.detail: paperforge would only become an option if the licence requirement were relaxed and legal approved AGPL.
